article: Article 33 - Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
supervisory_authority: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD - Portugal)

nature_of_the_breach.breach_type: Attempted reconstruction attack / policy violation: Differential Privacy Reconstruction Attack
nature_of_the_breach.gdpr_article_involved: Article 9 (Processing of special categories of personal data)
data_categories: Sensitive Health Attributes (Diagnoses, Blood Pressure, Glucose)

risk_and_consequences.severity_assessment: High risk to rights and freedoms of natural persons
risk_and_consequences.likely_consequences: Attempted singling-out or inference mitigated by automated gateway revocation.

applied_measures: Immediate token revocation and query endpoint isolation
Privacy Gateway rules updated to block suspicious pattern
